decision.rationale: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23. The disputed posting TXN-007876 posted on 2026-08-07, 77 days earlier, so it is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The ledger shows two purchases at BRAMBLE ENERGY (MER-000021) on this card, both for 52.02 EUR. TXN-007875 was made on 2026-08-05 at 21:50 and posted on 2026-08-06 under AUTH-008086. TXN-007876 was made on 2026-08-06 at 06:50 and posted on 2026-08-07 under AUTH-008087. They do not share an authorisation. Each was approved separately, about nine hours apart, with the card inserted (CHIP) and the correct PIN entered, and neither was flagged as possible fraud. No refund exists for either posting. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart count as two purchases, even when the merchant and amount are the same. The claim of a duplicate charge is therefore declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show two separate payments of 52.02 EUR to BRAMBLE ENERGY, on 5 August and 6 August 2026. Each was approved on its own, about nine hours apart, with your card inserted at the terminal and your PIN entered. These are two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice, so we cannot treat this as a duplicate charge.
